title: Benchmark telemetry harness
description: Objective: emit the machine-readable run, cost-class, timing, effort, settings, evidence-receipt, and reproducibility records required by the pinned benchmark. Deliverable: benchmark harness infrastructure without confirmatory corpus bytes. NOT in scope: competitor scoring or claim decisions. Hard dependencies: stable daemon/provider/control-room instrumentation. Owned paths: packages/benchmark/** excluding confirmatory corpus and campaign outputs. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark test.
definitionOfDone: Every required measurement has exact source/basis or explicit UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN is never zero or imputed across arms.
Run records bind model/profile/runtime/settings/source/evidence identities and all timing split points.
Harness self-tests cover censoring, cost bases, fixtures, concurrency, and receipt tamper.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.
reopenReason: Human-directed unblock after live capability/dependency audit: the runner evidence receipt pipeline (task-1e512b95), published runner recovery/evidence/Claude observation surface (task-7d0abdcd), live daemon/control-room seam (task-2d1f94f9), and control-room evidence timeline (task-d99ca771) are DONE. This task is harness infrastructure only and excludes corpus/campaign claims. Architect must re-measure current production instrumentation and report BLOCKED rather than invent any absent measurement source.

comments.author: governor-8466bf0e
comments.content:
GOVERNOR — RAIL PROPOSAL FILED FROM THIS TASK'S FINDING. prop-19dbad5a29294a83bb4e35a49abe0053, ADD_RAIL, scope GLOBAL, status PENDING human review. Author: governor-8466bf0e (moe.propose_rail takes no workerId param, so the proposal file records workerId "unknown" — this comment is the attribution).

Subject: a verification gate must prove it EXECUTED; exit 0 is not evidence.

Credit: architect-7f301fa7 found it and flagged it in this task's block reason and again on task-3a34adca and task-8af4562f. I reproduced it first-hand rather than propagating the note — from the repo root at HEAD d01a512:

    $ pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark test
    No projects matched the filters in "D:\projexts\moe-next"
    EXIT=0

`packages/benchmark` is genuinely absent; `ls packages/` = context, contracts, control-room-client, control-room-model, coordination, core, import, mcp, review, runner, scheduler, skills, store, testkit.

Why it is filed against THIS task: this task's own verification command IS that command, so the hazard is not hypothetical here — a worker could complete this task on a gate that executed zero tests. Whoever plans it must require a NONZERO executed-test count, never exit 0, exactly as the existing block reason says.

This changes nothing about the block. The block stands on its own measurement: launchClaudeWithTelemetry, parseClaudeResultTelemetry, ClaudeTelemetryHandoff and normalizeUsageMeasurement all have zero non-test callers under apps/, and the unblock is the five owners DONE AND each of those four greps returning >0 apps/ hits. I re-read that condition and am not lifting any part of it.

One correction to the block's annotations, for whoever picks this up — status flags in it have drifted, though the substance has not: it records task-ea27beb6 and task-159f4c21 as BLOCKED; both are not. task-ea27beb6 is PLANNING (plannable now — the provider-run contract it needs is committed at HEAD in 9d60091). task-159f4c21 is WORKING with assignedWorkerId null, 0 of 9 steps and workStartedAt null, i.e. an approved plan nobody has started; announced in #workers as claimable. Neither changes the unblock condition, because that condition is the four greps, not the flags.

priorHandoffs.pitfalls: THE NAMED VERIFICATION COMMAND IS VACUOUS TODAY: `pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark test` prints 'No projects matched the filters' and EXITS 0. Never accept exit 0 as this task's gate - require a nonzero executed test count from vitest's own summary line. See mem:pnpm-filter-on-a-missing-package-exits-zero. Second: do not substitute runtime/profile IDs for model snapshot or reasoning effort, and do not accept caller-supplied timing pairs in place of production observations - both were called out by the prior architect and both are still the easy wrong answer. Third: UNKNOWN must never be rendered as zero or imputed across arms (DoD 1); a zero cost and an unmeasured cost are different facts. Fourth: this is a Clause 2 task, so a fixture-fed harness is worse than no harness - if a source is still absent at planning time, block again rather than mock it.
priorHandoffs.openQuestions: The prior architect left this open and it is still open: freeze the exact stable UNKNOWN reason-code/layer vocabulary for the benchmark codec without adding campaign scoring. Also unresolved - the earlier handoff asked to 'widen ownership for pnpm-lock.yaml', which matters because creating packages/benchmark requires a workspace install; whoever plans this must declare pnpm-lock.yaml and the new package.json as owned paths in step 1 or the dependency-edge rail cannot be satisfied.
